Folks, let’s look at what is really happening here to our traditional order and our sacred duty of civic accountability. The establishment is terrified of anyone who dares to question their broken systems, and they will stop at nothing to protect the political elites like Republican state Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Democratic Racine Mayor Cory Mason. 

We saw this clear as day with Harry Wait, who leads a group spreading false election claims. In 2022, he requested the ballots of Vos and Mason without their consent. Why did he do it? He admitted he did this to try to prove that the state’s voter registration system is vulnerable to fraud. 

Instead of thanking a concerned citizen for exposing the glaring flaws in our voting systems and protecting basic security and order, the powers-that-be dragged him through the courts. Following a two-day trial, a Racine County jury on Tuesday found him guilty of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge, though he was thankfully acquitted of a second count of identity theft. 

This whole ordeal is nothing more than a targeted attempt by the ruling class to silence those who demand accountability and respect for our traditions. While everyday citizens who care about the integrity of our nation are punished, the real bad actors try to exploit the system with impunity. We cannot let them crush the spirit of personal responsibility and truth!
